templates.name: 31. 变焦模糊
templates.description: 动效转场：变焦模糊 / Zoom Blur — the camera zooms rapidly into the outgoing scene with heavy radial motion blur, the blurred streak snapping into a sharp new composition of the incoming scene
templates.description_en: Zoom Blur - the camera zooms rapidly into the outgoing scene with heavy radial motion blur, the blurred streak snapping into a sharp new composition of the incoming scene
templates.prompt:
A seamless Zoom Blur transition effect between two scenes.

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] [0-3s] The first scene holds steady in a cinematic composition. The frame is stable, the lighting is balanced, and the subject is clearly visible, establishing the visual context that will be transformed by the transition.
[Shot 2] [3-6s] The camera zooms rapidly into the outgoing scene with heavy radial motion blur, the blurred streak snapping into a sharp new composition of the incoming scene. The transition executes with fluid, natural motion and cinematic quality. The camera movement and visual effect remain smooth and continuous, completing the handoff from the first scene to the second scene seamlessly.

overall_soundscape: a fast zoom whoosh with lens rush. No dialogue, no music in the soundscape layer.

non_diegetic_music: a dramatic orchestral hit with low brass, synced to the rhythm of the transition for a polished editorial feel.
